enrichment-abilities.json.name: Warp Storms (Psychic)
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: At the end of your Movement phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 9" of a model with this ability; on a 3+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Grav-pinned
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Super-heavy Walker
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Annihilate the Unworthy
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Friendly KNIGHT TYRANT units' attacks that target a battle-shocked unit have +1 to the Hit roll.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Pterrorshade Rookery
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: KNIGHT TYRANT only. When selected to shoot, one enemy unit within 24" gains +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Hate-Filled Dominion
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: KNIGHT TYRANT only. Re-roll rolls to determine the Attacks characteristic of a weapon.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Pitiless Focus
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: A fall-back move does not prevent the KNIGHT TYRANT from being eligible to shoot.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Intimidating Reminder
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: One enemy unit hit by the KNIGHT TYRANT's attacks is suppressed until your next Command phase: while suppressed, its attacks have -1 to Hit rolls.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Scenting Fear
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Once per battle round, per army. In your Shooting phase, one visible enemy unit within 12" of a friendly WAR DOG gains +6" detection range. WAR DOGS detachment.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Soul-Spoor Auspicator
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: HUNTSMAN only. Ranged attacks have +6" Range.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Snarling Rivalry
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: EXECUTIONER only. Ranged attacks gain [IGNORES COVER].

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Leash of the Masters
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Shooting does not prevent the WAR DOG unit from being eligible to start an Action.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Stalking Focus
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Ranged attacks that target your WAR DOG unit (within range of an objective) have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Wretched Thralls
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: You can include DAMNED units (Codex: Chaos Space Marines), combined cost <= 500 pts. Friendly DAMNED units can re-roll Leadership rolls.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Cruel Lashmaster
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. While a friendly DAMNED unit is within 6", that unit gets +2" M when it makes a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move (until end of phase).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Iconoclast Idol
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: CHAOS KNIGHTS model only. While a friendly DAMNED unit is within 6", the Heroic Intervention stratagem targeting that unit costs -1 CP.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Avenge the Masters!
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: When a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS unit is destroyed by an enemy unit, that enemy unit is Marked until the end of the battle. Friendly DAMNED units' attacks targeting a Marked unit have [LETHAL HITS].

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Dark Sacrifice
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In your Command phase: a friendly DAMNED unit (excluding ACCURSED CULTISTS) within 9" of a CHAOS KNIGHTS model suffers D3+3 mortal wounds; a CHAOS KNIGHTS model within 9" heals that many wounds.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Coursing Thralls
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Start of your Shooting phase: a friendly DAMNED unit marks one visible enemy unit within 12" as Hunted (+6" detection range).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Masters of the Pack
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: If a Titanic Chaos Knights unit has an Aura ability affecting friendly War Dog units, while two or more friendly War Dog models are within range of that aura, the Titanic unit is also affected by that aura.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Hunter's Helm
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Chaos Knights model only. Re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for the bearer's unit.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Octagram of Conjuration
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Enhancement, Knight Abominant model only. Aura: while a friendly War Dog model is within 9" of the bearer, after that War Dog shoots you can select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks; that unit must take a Battle-shock test. [APPROX] Selection is restricted to an enemy unit that was hit by that War Dog's shooting attacks; the effect tree names the forced Battle-shock test but does not gate the pick on the hit.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Throne Tyrannicus
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Titanic Chaos Knights only. In your Command phase, one other Chaos Knights Character within 9" is also affected by the bearer's Auras that affect friendly War Dog units, until your next Command phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Aspect of the Beast
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Chaos Knights model only. At the start of your Command phase, one Dread ability is active for the bearer until your next Command phase, in addition to your army's active Dread abilities.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Merciless Fusillade
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: One Titanic Chaos Knights unit and up to two friendly War Dog units must each focus one eligible enemy target; those attacks gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Beasthide Manifestation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Until the attacking unit finishes its attacks, each attack targeting your Chaos Knights unit worsens its Armour Penetration by 1.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Flush the Quarry
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Contemptuous Volleys
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: After a Chaos Knights unit Falls Back, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Goaded Beast
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit shoots, a Chaos Knights unit that lost wounds can make a D6" surge move.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Harbingers of Dread
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Harbingers of Dread army rule. Deathly Terror is always active: worsen the Ld of enemy units within 9" by 1. At the start of battle rounds 1, 3 and 5, select one further Dread ability (or roll 2D6 for two) to stay active for the battle: (1) a further -1 Ld within 9" (cumulative); (2) +1 to Wound vs Battle-shocked targets; (3) Darkness = this model has Stealth (Faction Pack v1.0 update, was -1 to be hit by Battle-shocked/>18" attackers); (4) below-Starting-Strength enemies within 9" take a Battle-shock test in the opponent's Command phase; (5) D3 mortal wounds when a Below Half-strength enemy within 9" fails a Battle-shock test; (6) +3" to this model's Aura range.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Dreadblades
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Dreadblades: if every model in your army has the CHAOS keyword, you may include 1 TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS model or up to 3 WAR DOG models that lack the chosen Faction keyword. They cannot be your Warlord and cannot take Enhancements.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Tyrannical Court
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER models have +2 Objective Control. In addition, once per battle round, if your Warlord is on the battlefield, you can use the Claimed for the Dark Gods Stratagem for 0CP. [APPROX] The once-per-battle-round limit and the Warlord-on-battlefield gate on the free Stratagem are not encoded in the effect tree (no once-per-battle-round usage frequency; no warlord-presence condition id).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Claimed for the Dark Gods
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. Start of your Command phase (Faction Pack v1.0). A CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER within range of an objective you control keeps that objective (Level of Control 5) until your opponent's control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Spiteful Demise
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. Just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER is destroyed: its Deadly Demise inflicts mortal wounds on a 4+ instead of a 6.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Titanic Duel
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP Stratagem, used in your Shooting or Fight phase against one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. If the chosen unit is TITANIC, make full re-rolls of Hit and Wound rolls instead of only 1s.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Trophy Hunter
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. Before a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER consolidates: it can Consolidate up to an extra 3", provided it ends within Engagement Range of an enemy unit.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Crushed Like Vermin
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. After a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER ends a Normal move: pick a non-MONSTER/VEHICLE enemy it moved over and roll 6D6 — each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound; if any model dies, that unit takes a Battle-shock test.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Runes of Disdain
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 2CP. Reactive, after an enemy selects targets: subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of each attack allocated to your CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Throne Mechanicum of Skulls
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 25pts. Re-roll Charge rolls for the bearer's unit. Once per battle, the unit can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blade of Celerity
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 35pts. The bearer's ranged weapons have [ASSAULT]. Once per battle, in the Fight phase, the bearer's unit has Fights First.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Warp-borne Stalker
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 25pts. The bearer has Deep Strike. Once per battle, at the end of the opponent's turn, if not in Engagement Range, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Putrid Carapace
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 30pts. The bearer has a Save of 2+. Once per battle, at the start of either Command phase, it regains up to D6 lost wounds.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Mirror of Fates
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 30pts (Faction Pack v1.0). Once per battle round, the bearer's unit can be targeted with the Command Re-roll Stratagem for 0CP, even if another unit was already targeted by it this phase. In addition, once per battle, just after the opponent uses a Stratagem, the CP cost they must pay to use that Stratagem again is increased by 1CP.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blessing of the Dark Master
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 20pts. The bearer has Stealth. Once per battle, after a saving throw for the bearer, change that attack's Damage to 0.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Malefic Surge
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In your Command phase, CHAOS KNIGHTS units can make a Malefic Surge: take a Ld test (D3 mortal wounds on a fail), then become Empowered until your next Command phase. An Empowered unit may use one Malefic Surge ability once: Unholy Hunger (+3" Move on a Normal/Advance/Fall Back move), Diabolic Power ([LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]), or Unnatural Fortitude (5+ invulnerable save OR Feel No Pain 6+ — Faction Pack v1.0).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Profane Symbiosis
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. End of any phase: a non-Empowered CHAOS KNIGHTS unit makes a Malefic Surge. Not the same unit more than once per battle round.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Hellforged Construction
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP (Faction Pack v1.0). Reactive in the Fight phase: until the attacking unit finishes, worsen by 1 the Armour Penetration of each attack targeting your unit.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Corrupting Taint
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. After a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER makes a Malefic Surge: an objective it controls stays yours until the opponent's control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Unleash Balefire
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. After your unit shoots, a unit it hit takes a Battle-shock test; if failed it is aflame until the end of the opponent's next turn (-2" Move and -2 to Charge rolls).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Warp Vision
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. Your Shooting phase: ranged weapons in your unit have [IGNORES COVER].

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Diabolic Bulwark
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. Reactive in the opponent's Shooting phase: models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Knight Diabolus
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 25pts. Improve the WS of the bearer's melee weapons by 1; while using Diabolic Power they also have [LANCE].

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blasphemous Engine
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 35pts. +2 Wounds. Re-roll the Leadership test when the bearer's unit makes a Malefic Surge.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Fleshmetal Fusion
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 35pts. +1 Toughness. While using Unnatural Fortitude, +1 to armour saves against Damage-1 attacks.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Bestial Aspect
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 20pts. The bearer's ranged weapons have [ASSAULT]. While using Unholy Hunger it can ignore Move/Advance modifiers.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Marked Prey
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Only WAR DOG models' attacks benefit, and only while the marked unit is visible to the attacker.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Hungry for Combat
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. When 2+ WAR DOG units are in Engagement Range of the same enemy: they can only target that enemy, and their Hit rolls of 5+ score Critical Hits.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Animalistic Rage
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP (Faction Pack v1.0). Just after a WAR DOG unit that has not been selected to attack this phase is destroyed: before its Deadly Demise resolves, it can shoot or fight, targeting only the unit that destroyed it.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Vox-Howl
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 2CP, once per turn. Enemy units within 6" of your WAR DOG CHARACTER take a Battle-shock test; friendly WAR DOG units within 6" can pass a Ld test to lose Battle-shock.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Cunning Hunter
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. After a WAR DOG unit Falls Back: it is eligible to shoot and to declare a charge this turn.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Harrying Hounds
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP (Faction Pack v1.0). Reactive, after an enemy ends a move within 8" of your WAR DOG unit (was 9"): your unit makes a Normal move of up to 6".

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Encircling Pack
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. End of the opponent's Fight phase: a WAR DOG unit wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge and not in Engagement Range is placed into Strategic Reserves.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Preyslayer's Mantle
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 15pts. The WAR DOG bearer has the Super-heavy Walker ability.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Final Howl (Aura)
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 20pts. Aura: while a friendly WAR DOG is within 6" of the bearer, re-roll its Wound rolls of 1.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Loping Predator
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 10pts. The WAR DOG bearer's ranged weapons have [ASSAULT].

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Panoply of the Cursed Knights
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 15pts. Each attack targeting the WAR DOG bearer has its Armour Penetration worsened by 1.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Paragons of Terror
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: At the start of the first battle round, after selecting Dread abilities, select one additional Dread ability to be active for your army (cannot be randomly selected).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Conquerors Without Mercy
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. Fight phase, a CHAOS KNIGHTS model that charged this turn: improve the AP of its melee weapons by 1; if it destroys a unit this phase, enemy units within 6" take a Battle-shock test.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Imperious Advance
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored from 10e source (provisional 11e); see #21

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Disdain for the Weak
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. Reactive in the Fight phase: your unit has Feel No Pain 6+, and Feel No Pain 5+ against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: A Long Leash
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. Your Command phase: up to two friendly WAR DOG units are treated as within range of your ABHORRENT model's Aura abilities until your next Command phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Storm of Darkness
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 1CP. Reactive in the opponent's Shooting phase: models in your unit have Stealth and the Benefit of Cover.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Pterrorshades
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] 1CP, once per battle round (not gated — no once-per-battle-round frequency exists). After an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test, a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit within 12" rolls 6D6: each 4+ deals that enemy unit 1 mortal wound. The paired heal (one model in your unit regains 1 lost wound per 4+) cannot share the same dice pool and is not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Nightmare's Master
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 20pts. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit in Engagement Range of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Tyrant's Shadow
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 25pts. At the end of your Command phase, an objective the bearer controls stays yours until the opponent's control exceeds yours; while held it has the Deathly Terror ability.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Malevolent Heraldry
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 30pts. When you roll to randomly select active Dread abilities, you can re-roll one or both results.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Veil of Medrengard
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 35pts. The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks and a 5+ invulnerable save against melee attacks.
